text:
Alyssa (People Ops): Quick update: new Emergency Quarantine & Relocation Support policy for work travel is live. Effective immediately for any company-approved travel where unexpected border closures, public health orders, or quarantine requirements cause additional lodging/meals/transportation costs. Full policy + claim form: https://redwood.atlassian.org/people-ops/travel/quarantine-support-2026 

Ops-Safety-Bot: Policy published. Includes checklist: pre-trip risk assessment, emergency contact, and required documentation for claims.

Marcus Nguyen: Huge — nice timing. Two quick q's: 1) Does this apply to personal travel on PTO if a customer meeting gets moved? 2) What counts as "company-approved travel"?

Alyssa (People Ops): 1) Policy only covers business travel (approved by manager or via booked vendor). Personal travel on PTO is excluded. 2) "Company-approved travel" = trips booked on a Redwood travel request, a manager-approved client visit, or events where Redwood is invoiced/charging. If in doubt, save the approval email or the travel request ID.

Sofia Romero: Is there an upper cap on hotel nights covered during quarantine? Last minute quarantine can be a week+ in some places.

Alyssa (People Ops): We cover up to 14 consecutive nights per event at the reasonable nightly rate for that location (company policy uses market median from our vendor data). If longer is required for legal reasons, escalate to people-ops@redwood.com and we'll review case-by-case. 

Finance-Team: Note: For quarantine support claims, Finance requires itemized receipts + proof of quarantine order (email from authority, hotel notice, or public health link) and the travel request ID. Per-diem rules apply for meals unless company card used.

Marcus Nguyen: For team members who get stuck overseas, is emergency repatriation covered? Return flights/prorated seat upgrades?

Alyssa (People Ops): Emergency repatriation is supported when recommended by Ops-Safety or required by an evacuation advisory. Economy return ticket covered; upgrades only on medical/operational necessity and require Ops-Safety sign-off.

Ops-Safety-Bot: Reminder: pre-trip high-risk flag will prompt a required 24-hour pre-trip sync with Ops-Safety. Use /travel-check to flag trips.

Sofia Romero: What about dependents or partner travel if they were on the same booking?

Alyssa (People Ops): Dependents or partner costs are not automatically covered unless they are Redwood contractors/vendors or their presence is required for work duties (rare). If partners are part of a vendor booking where Redwood has contractual obligation, submit details for review.

Marcus Nguyen: Any changes to receipts — multiple small charges are a pain. Can we do a single consolidated invoice?

Finance-Team: Consolidated invoices are fine if they clearly list dates and names. For card charges, attach the corporate card statement plus any merchant invoice. If using personal card, attach full receipts.

Alyssa (People Ops): Filing tip: create a "Quarantine Support" claim type in the expense tool and attach: travel request ID, proof of quarantine, itemized receipts, and a short narrative of events. Example narrative: "Stranded in Lisbon 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-16 due to quarantine order; hotel nights x6, breakfasts included; return flight rebooked 2026-06-17. Travel Request ID: TR-3349"

Ops-Safety-Bot: If you are stranded and need immediate assistance, DM @Ops-Safety or call the emergency line in the pre-trip checklist. Live support available 24/7 for escalations.

Sofia Romero: Timeline for reimbursement? Some people are on tight budgets and fronting costs.

Finance-Team: Emergency reimbursements will be prioritized. Submit within 5 business days of returning or of the end of the quarantine event. For urgent cases, include "URGENT-QUARANTINE" in the expense subject and Finance will expedite (typical turnaround 3-7 business days).

Marcus Nguyen: Great, will add to our team playbook. Are managers required to approve rebooking costs?

Alyssa (People Ops): Manager approval still required for air rebookings over $500 unless Ops-Safety mandated the change. People-ops can approve exceptions when Ops-Safety or Finance recommends it.

Sofia Romero: Will there be a short office hours walkthrough? Feels like a lot to absorb for global teams.

Alyssa (People Ops): Yes 15 minute drop-in tomorrow 09:30 PT in #people-ops-office-hours. I'll post the slide deck and the quick checklist in the policy doc. Thanks all 44d

Marcus Nguyen: Thanks Alyssa, super helpful.

Sofia Romero: Thank you!
